note: SEALED unseen Q-set v1 (agent-authored 2026-10-17 by an independent reviewer session; pending owner review; never used for tuning)

questions.text: A standard OPEX order for office chairs comes to 1,750,000 JPY and the supplier is not flagged. Which role has to review it?

expected.rationale: rule-standard-manager-review (>= 1,000,000 JPY, STANDARD) is the only rule whose condition the stated OPEX amount and normal supplier satisfy; the CAPEX rules need category CAPEX and the Director rule needs HIGH risk.

questions.text: If a stationery requisition is worth 650,000 JPY, does any person have to sign it before the order goes out?

expected.rationale: 650,000 JPY is under the 1,000,000 JPY manager line in rule-standard-manager-review and procurement_policy.md section 3.3 says such standard requisitions are cleared automatically; no other approval rule is triggered.

questions.text: The vendor on a 300,000 JPY order is rated HIGH risk. Is anyone's authorization needed, and whose?

expected.rationale: rule-high-risk-director has no amount condition (supplier.risk == HIGH only) and policy section 3.1 says the Director requirement holds regardless of amount, so the low amount does not remove it.

questions.text: Our order has a net goods value of 420,000 JPY. Will we be charged for shipping?

expected.rationale: rule-shipping-fee (order.net_goods_jpy < 500,000) applies and names the 2,000 JPY charge; the free-freight rule needs 500,000 or more and the approval rules are unrelated to freight.

questions.text: A standard CAPEX requisition of 6,000,000 JPY names a supplier on the HIGH-risk list. List every role that has to review it.

expected.rationale: 6,000,000 JPY satisfies the manager rule (>= 1,000,000), the CAPEX Finance rule on both the decided 2,000,000 side and the policy 5,000,000 side, and the HIGH-risk condition sends it to the Director; all three roles are reachable from the structured rules.

questions.text: An OPEX purchase of 2,500,000 JPY from a supplier with normal risk, standard process. Does Finance have to look at it, and who does?

expected.rationale: Both CAPEX Finance rules require request.category == CAPEX, which OPEX fails, and the supplier is not HIGH risk, so only rule-standard-manager-review (>= 1,000,000 JPY) applies; the finance desk guide's 2,000,000 rule of thumb is not a structured rule.

questions.text: A 480,000 JPY requisition is for a supplier whose status is BLOCKED. Because it is under the manager line, is it cleared automatically?

expected.rationale: rule-blocked-supplier rejects any requisition for a BLOCKED supplier and policy section 3.1 gives vendor restrictions precedence; the amount being under rule-standard-manager-review's 1,000,000 JPY line does not make it an automatic approval.

questions.text: An emergency OPEX requisition of 1,300,000 JPY: does the standard manager approval rule bind it, or does the emergency process change who reviews?

expected.rationale: rule-standard-manager-review is scoped to STANDARD only and rule-emergency-routing has no evaluable condition or actor (PENDING_HUMAN, divergent implementation), so the approver for a 1,300,000 JPY emergency OPEX request cannot be stated with certainty.

questions.text: When a requisition is flagged EMERGENCY, does the Director requirement for HIGH-risk vendors lapse?

expected.rationale: rule-high-risk-director's scope lists both STANDARD and EMERGENCY and emergency_purchases.md section 2.1 states emergency status does not bypass vendor risk controls.

questions.text: Who must review a standard CAPEX requisition of 3,200,000 JPY for a forklift from a supplier with normal risk?

expected.rationale: 3,200,000 JPY meets the manager rule and the decided CAPEX Finance line of 2,000,000 JPY (rule-capex-finance-config); the policy's 5,000,000 JPY side (rule-capex-finance-policy) is not met and should be disclosed as the disagreeing value, which forces PARTIAL if disclosed.

questions.text: A standard CAPEX laptop refresh of 1,400,000 JPY from an ordinary supplier: which approvals does it need?

expected.rationale: 1,400,000 JPY is at or above the type-agnostic manager line but below both CAPEX Finance values (2,000,000 decided and 5,000,000 policy), so only rule-standard-manager-review fires; the supplier is not HIGH risk.

questions.text: How many competing quotes must a buyer collect before raising a 2,000,000 JPY OPEX requisition?

expected.rationale: No structured rule or source passage sets a quotation count; the 2,000,000 JPY figure matches the CAPEX Finance line only by number and the request is OPEX, so citing those rules would be a misapplication.

questions.text: What approval is needed to extend a supplier's payment terms from 30 to 60 days?

expected.rationale: rule-payment-term states that invoices are paid within 30 days; neither it nor any other rule governs who may change a supplier's terms, so the matter is outside the structured knowledge.

questions.text: Which role approves returning a lot to the supplier after it arrived damaged?

expected.rationale: The SOP only says damaged lots are logged as DAMAGED and excluded from payable quantities; no structured rule assigns an approver for returns, and the receipt-matching and purchase-approval rules do not cover it.
